mechanism_narrative: Rising quarterly GDP (GDPC1) indicates strengthening demand, boosting corporate earnings and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20-day forward returns in expanding economies are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the Federal Funds Rate above 4.5% signals monetary tightening, increasing discount rates on future cash flows and compressing equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in tightening cycles are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or FEDFUNDS remain below 4.5% despite negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in the Federal Funds Rate and Unemployment Rate signal economic expansion, lowering long-term interest rates and boosting investor confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Interaction effect not statistically significant (p > 0.05) or 5-day returns not positively correlated with the proxy changes.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, rising Industrial Production (INDPRO) and Payroll Employment (PAYEMS) reflect sustained demand and labor market strength, reinforcing equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns in late-cycle expansion are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) or INDPRO/PAYEMS do not rise concurrently with returns.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent declines in the Federal Funds Rate indicate an easing monetary policy cycle, lowering discount rates on equity cash flows and enhancing present value, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns in easing cycles are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) or FEDFUNDS remain elevated despite positive returns.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the Unemployment Rate below 4% signals a strengthening labor market, boosting consumer confidence and corporate profits, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns in low unemployment periods are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) or UNRATE remains above 4% despite positive returns.

mechanism_narrative: An upward crossing of the CPIAUCSL index above 2.0% signals rising inflation expectations, eroding real returns and prompting risk aversion, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns in inflationary periods are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) or CPIAUCSL remains below 2.0% despite negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, rising GDP (GDPC1) and low inflation (CPIAUCSL) indicate a resilient economy, fostering optimism and equity valuation growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns in post-shock recovery are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) or GDPC1/CPIAUCSL do not rise concurrently with returns.
